title: Polynomial-Time Computation of the Stored Round
statement: For every finite Boolean-alphabet Turing machine $M$, the function sending a Boolean word $z$ to the unary word whose length is its stored last-round index is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean-alphabet Turing machine
replaced: For every source machine, the function sending a persistent body word to the unary word of its stored last-round index is polynomial-time computable; every projection and fixed repetition carries a native ledger.
